description: `[1,2].map(&:to_s)` has *no* block node at all: the desugarer produces `blockpass (sym to_s)`, and Ruby coerces the Symbol to a proc (Symbol#to_proc) at call time. There is no Ty for that coercion, so the claim is stated on the whole send's *result* (arrayOf String) instead -- honest, and enough here, but it means a checker needs a Symbol#to_proc rule (sym `s` used as a block over receiver `T` behaves as the arrow of T's `s` method) before it can synthesize this without help.
